Senders enqueue calls by inserting rows into generated outbox tables, which are insert-only and map their columns to the receiver's reducer parameters with compile-time type checking. Delivery is handled by a new IDC actor that manages concurrent outbox streams over HTTP/2, and optional `on_result` / `onResult` callbacks report delivery outcomes back to the sender. The datastore no longer clones the full subscriber state for each transaction. It records transaction-local subscriber and timestamp changes instead, substantially reducing memory usage for databases with many subscribers while preserving subscription and view behavior.
The new `spacetime auth` command group lets Maincloud users manage a database's SpacetimeAuth configuration from the command line. It supports identity-provider configuration, project settings, and client creation, inspection, and deletion.

SpacetimeDB now rejects JWTs signed with `HS256`. Symmetric signing cannot be validated through an issuer's public key in the same way as supported asymmetric algorithms, so these tokens are no longer accepted for authentication.

## v3.2.0 — Safe capture foundation

The first phase of the 2026 roadmap: make Slower something you confidently leave on in production, and make every capture know **what it is** (a fingerprint) and **where it came from** (its origin). No breaking changes — additive migration, existing config/API untouched, synchronous analysis still the default.

## Bug fixes

- Fixed a `socket hang up` error on a request that took over a socket released by an earlier request, when another request queued for that socket was aborted in between. The orphaned idle-socket timer from the earlier release destroyed the socket `idle_socket_ttl` later, mid-request (Node.js only) ([#1040]). ([#1041])

[#1040]: https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-js/issues/1040
[#1041]: https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-js/pull/1041

- Added a `span_attributes` field to the per-request query params (`query` / `command` / `exec` / `insert` / `ping`). Use it to enrich the operation span with application-level context — e.g. mirroring the tags you also send via the `log_comment` setting (route, tenant, surface, etc.). Caller-provided attributes never override the client's own `db.*` / `server.*` / `clickhouse.*` attributes.
- Added a `dangerously_log_query_text` client option (default `false`). When enabled, the raw SQL statement is atta

- Every key present in the summary header is now recorded as `clickhouse.summary.<key>` (the set is no longer a hardcoded subset). This surfaces `total_rows_to_read` (already typed but never recorded) and `memory_usage` (peak query memory, in bytes; sent by newer servers), and picks up future server-side additions (e.g. `real_time_microseconds`) automatically.
